title: tanh-GELU decomposition -> builtin GELU op (exact erf)

rewrite.equivalence_evidence: DINOv2-S features: erf build vs tanh build corr 0.999992, max_abs 0.055; erf is the official model's own activation, so the builtin op is MORE faithful than the tanh chain it replaces

measurement.gpu_control: same swap on the S26 Adreno: 54.2 -> 55.2 ms (no effect; ML Drift ran the builtin GELU op — Mali unverified)

scope: one real model (DINOv2-S, T=1025, d=384, 12 blocks) plus the matched synthetic probe family; MLP tensors [1,T,1536]
notes: This swap alone flipped DINOv2-S from losing 0.63x to winning 1.32x vs the GPU. 2026-08-28: builtin GELU op also compiles and runs on Mali (Pixel 8a, LiteRT 2.2.0, 198.8 ms GPU) - the Mali-era 'GELU must be rewritten' ban is gone at this runtime. GELU(approximate=True) build: 38.5 ms NPU (c0_ab_tanhop.log).
